name: Todd Becker
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Pasadena, California
side_practice_areas: Personal Injury, Class Action & Mass Torts, Business Litigation
about: Attorney Todd Becker is the founder and senior partner of Becker Law Group in Pasadena, California. Mr. Becker represents individuals, families, and communities throughout California in complex, high-stakes litigation involving personal injury, wildfire losses, sexual abuse and institutional liability, mass torts, business litigation, wrongful death, and other catastrophic injury matters. He is committed to holding negligent individuals, corporations, and institutions accountable while helping clients pursue meaningful compensation and justice.

Over the course of his career, Mr. Becker has been involved in many high-profile cases, securing several multimillion-dollar recoveries for his clients through verdicts and settlements. He has represented hundreds of wildfire survivors and has extensive experience handling complex litigation involving institutional misconduct, toxic exposure, and catastrophic losses.

Additionally, Mr. Becker has handled many cases in China and within California's Chinese community. He has lectured on international law topics at institutions including Georgetown University, Wuhan Technology and Business University, Tsinghua University, and the China-U.S. Business Summit. Committed to serving his local community, he sits on the board of Urban Compass and is a member of the Asian Youth Center.

In recognition of his accomplishments, the American Institute of Personal Injury Attorneys named Mr. Becker one of its "10 Best Attorneys." He has also been recognized by Lawyers of Distinction , Orange Coast magazine, and Pasadena Magazine .

Mr. Becker earned his bachelor's degree in political science from the University of California, Los Angeles, and his Juris Doctor from Pepperdine University Caruso School of Law. He is licensed to practice before all California state courts and is a member of the Pasadena Bar Association, the Los Angeles County Bar Association, the Consumer Attorneys Association of Los Angeles, and the Southern California Chinese Lawyers Association.
